selection_rule: positional: the first 10 rows of sample_requests.csv are calibration, the remaining 15 are hold-out

calibration.purpose: prompt calibration, few-shot examples, and developer-visible error analysis

holdout.purpose: one-time hidden evaluation after prompts, model settings, tools, thresholds, and policies are frozen

rules: Hold-out expected output values must never enter prompts, few-shot examples, caches, traces, or tuning artifacts.
Only code/evaluation/evaluate_holdout.py may read hold-out labels.
The hold-out runs once; re-tuning after inspecting it means declaring the hold-out contaminated.
Sample-request rows are never used as labels for dataset/requests.csv predictions.
Sample users (user_01..user_25) are disjoint from evaluation users (user_26..user_275), so no user-level state is shared across the split.
